```{r setup}
project_root <- if (dir.exists("_targets")) "." else if (dir.exists("../_targets")) ".." else stop("Could not locate _targets store.")
renv_activate <- file.path(project_root, "renv", "activate.R")
if (file.exists(renv_activate)) {
  source(renv_activate)
}
library(targets)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
if (requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(path = normalizePath(project_root), export_all = FALSE, helpers = FALSE)
} else if (requireNamespace("devtools", quietly = TRUE)) {
  devtools::load_all(path = normalizePath(project_root), export_all = FALSE)
}
tar_config_set(store = file.path(project_root, "_targets"))
truth <- tar_read(synthetic_reference_truth)
mode_runs <- tar_read(synthetic_reference_runs)
theta_star <- tar_read(synthetic_theta_star)
synthetic_cfg <- tar_read(synthetic_cfg)
recovery <- tar_read(synthetic_recovery_tables)
rep_metrics <- recovery$replicate_metrics
param_recovery <- recovery$parameter_recovery
benchmark_summary <- recovery$benchmark_summary %||% tibble::tibble()
pilot_gates <- recovery$pilot_gates %||% tibble::tibble()
benchmark_cfg <- tryCatch(tar_read(synthetic_benchmark_cfg), error = function(...) list())
pilot_gate_cfg <- tryCatch(tar_read(synthetic_pilot_gate_cfg), error = function(...) list())
stress_outputs <- tryCatch(tar_read(synthetic_stress_outputs), error = function(...) list())
stress_scenarios <- stress_outputs$scenarios %||% tibble::tibble()
stress_gate_pass <- stress_outputs$gate_pass %||% tibble::tibble()
stress_scenario_pass <- stress_outputs$scenario_pass %||% tibble::tibble()
stress_metrics <- stress_outputs$metrics %||% tibble::tibble()
grid_info <- tar_read(synthetic_grid_info)
recovery_cfg <- tar_read(synthetic_recovery_cfg)
plot_surface <- function(mat, title) exdyn_plot_surface(mat, grid_info, title)
```

::: {.callout-note}
### Glossary (synthetic workflow)
- **TX**: extirpation year surface (year voles disappear in each grid cell).
- **TX_true**: simulator ground truth extirpation year per cell.
- **TX_obs**: extirpation year inferred after observation + TX estimator (what ABC sees).
- **Screen**: fast filter over parameter draws; simulates TX, computes summaries, ranks draws.
- **Benchmark**: config-driven recovery classification over declared `benchmark.core_params`.
- **Pilot gates**: hard pass/fail checks (arrival coverage, TX coverage, informative summaries) that stop the pipeline if data are uninformative.
- **TX_best / TX_diff**: best screen draw and its difference vs TX_true (only written if screen runs and gates pass).
:::

## Configuration snapshot

```{r cfg}
tibble::tibble(
  n_reps = recovery_cfg$n_reps %||% NA_integer_,
  reference_rep = recovery_cfg$reference_rep %||% NA_integer_,
  modes = paste(unique(rep_metrics$mode), collapse = ", "),
  benchmark_stance = benchmark_cfg$stance %||% NA_character_,
  benchmark_core_params = paste(benchmark_cfg$core_params %||% character(), collapse = ", "),
  abc_optional_missing_penalty = synthetic_cfg$abc$optional_missing_penalty %||% NA_real_
)
```

```{r theta-table}
tibble::as_tibble(theta_star)
```

## Mode comparison (replicated recovery)

```{r mode-summary}
rep_metrics %>%
  group_by(mode) %>%
  summarise(
    n_reps = dplyr::n(),
    n_accept_median = stats::median(n_accept, na.rm = TRUE),
    screen_loss_median = stats::median(screen_best_loss, na.rm = TRUE),
    screen_r2_median = stats::median(screen_best_r2, na.rm = TRUE),
    screen_lag_median = stats::median(screen_best_lag, na.rm = TRUE),
    abc_r2_median = stats::median(abc_r2_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    abc_lag_median = stats::median(abc_lag_median, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Benchmark status

```{r benchmark-summary}
if (nrow(benchmark_summary)) {
  benchmark_summary %>%
    arrange(.data$mode) %>%
    select(
      .data$mode,
      .data$stance,
      .data$n_core_params_expected,
      .data$n_core_params_present,
      .data$n_core_recoverable,
      .data$n_core_weak_id,
      .data$n_core_not_recoverable,
      .data$n_core_unassessed,
      .data$core_params_missing,
      .data$overall_benchmark_pass
    )
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "No benchmark summary available for this run.")
}
```

```{r recovery-table}
if (nrow(param_recovery) && all(c("mode", "abs_bias") %in% names(param_recovery))) {
  param_recovery %>%
    arrange(.data$mode, desc(.data$abs_bias)) %>%
    select(
      .data$mode,
      .data$param,
      tidyselect::any_of("core_param"),
      .data$truth,
      .data$bias,
      .data$rel_bias_median,
      .data$abs_rel_bias_median,
      .data$coverage_80,
      .data$coverage_95,
      .data$identifiability_status,
      .data$gate_pass,
      .data$shrinkage_ratio
    )
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "No parameter recovery table available (empty or missing columns).")
}
```

```{r recovery-plot}
if (nrow(param_recovery) && all(c("abs_bias", "coverage_80", "mode") %in% names(param_recovery))) {
  param_recovery %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data$abs_bias)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = .data$abs_bias, y = .data$coverage_80, color = .data$mode)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey70") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = "Recovery tradeoff (abs bias vs 80% coverage)", x = "Absolute bias", y = "Coverage (80%)")
}
```

## Pilot gate checks

```{r pilot-gate-thresholds}
if (length(pilot_gate_cfg$thresholds %||% list())) {
  tibble::enframe(pilot_gate_cfg$thresholds, name = "threshold", value = "value")
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "No resolved pilot-gate thresholds available for this run.")
}
```

```{r pilot-gates}
if (nrow(pilot_gates)) {
  pilot_gates %>%
    arrange(.data$mode, .data$replicate, .data$gate) %>%
    mutate(pass = ifelse(.data$pass, "PASS", "FAIL"))
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "No pilot gate table available for this run.")
}
```

## Failure regimes (stress mini-sweep)

```{r stress-config}
if (nrow(stress_scenarios)) {
  stress_scenarios %>%
    count(arrival_source, obs_multiplier, pred_scale_multiplier, name = "n_scenarios") %>%
    arrange(arrival_source, obs_multiplier, pred_scale_multiplier)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "Stress sweep not enabled for this run.")
}
```

```{r stress-pass-rates}
if (nrow(stress_scenario_pass)) {
  stress_scenario_pass %>%
    arrange(arrival_source, obs_multiplier, pred_scale_multiplier) %>%
    select(arrival_source, obs_multiplier, pred_scale_multiplier, pass_rate_all_gates, n_reps)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "No stress scenario pass-rate table available.")
}
```

```{r stress-gates}
if (nrow(stress_gate_pass)) {
  stress_gate_pass %>%
    arrange(gate, arrival_source, obs_multiplier, pred_scale_multiplier) %>%
    select(gate, arrival_source, obs_multiplier, pred_scale_multiplier, pass_rate, n)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "No stress gate pass-rate table available.")
}
```

```{r stress-interpretation}
if (nrow(stress_metrics)) {
  stress_metrics %>%
    group_by(arrival_source, obs_multiplier, pred_scale_multiplier) %>%
    summarise(
      n_reps = dplyr::n(),
      median_n_accept = median(n_accept, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_abc_r2 = median(abc_r2_median, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_abc_lag = median(abc_lag_median, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_screen_cov = median(screen_best_coverage, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(arrival_source, obs_multiplier, pred_scale_multiplier)
} else {
  tibble::tibble(note = "No stress replicate metrics available.")
}
```

```{r stress-plot}
if (nrow(stress_scenario_pass)) {
  ggplot(stress_scenario_pass, aes(
    x = factor(obs_multiplier),
    y = factor(pred_scale_multiplier),
    fill = pass_rate_all_gates
  )) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", pass_rate_all_gates)), size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~arrival_source) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C", limits = c(0, 1), na.value = "grey85") +
    labs(
      title = "Failure regimes: all-gate pass rate",
      subtitle = "Lower values indicate identifiability collapse",
      x = "Observation multiplier (po_rate)",
      y = "Predation scale multiplier",
      fill = "Pass rate"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

## Reference maps (replicate `r recovery_cfg$reference_rep %||% 1`)

```{r ref-maps}
plots <- lapply(mode_runs, function(run) {
  best <- run$best_tx
  p_true <- plot_surface(truth$TX_true, "TX_true")
  p_obs <- plot_surface(truth$TX_obs, "TX_obs")
  p_best <- if (!is.null(best)) plot_surface(best, paste("Best TX (", run$mode, ")", sep = "")) else ggplot()
  p_diff <- if (!is.null(best)) plot_surface(best - truth$TX_true, paste("Best - true (", run$mode, ")", sep = "")) else ggplot()
  patchwork::wrap_plots(p_true, p_obs, p_best, p_diff, ncol = 2)
})
if (length(plots)) {
  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = 1)
}
```
